trace.question:
I didn't send a payment because your request doesn't match what's in the system. You asked for Fjord Analytics's approved invoice, but they have **two** approved invoices, and I don't want to guess which one you mean:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30103 | $4,332.36 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-50292 | $5,384.89 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other invoices can't be paid now: INV-59460 ($4,391.78) is already marked paid, and INV-91213 ($7,010.11) is a draft awaiting approval. No payments have been sent from the operating account yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

Which do you want paid: INV-30103, INV-50292 or both? Once you tell me, I'll send each one once by wire, using ACH only if wire isn't available. Both amounts are under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-50292, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-50292, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-50292 in full by wire. The payment went through once and was confirmed.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-50292 (Fjord Analytics, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $5,384.89
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent; the invoice is now marked paid

It was under the $10,000 limit, so it didn't need controller approval. I sent it with a unique ID that stops it from being paid twice if the request were repeated. I didn't touch INV-30103 ($4,332.36), the invoice under dispute, so it's still open.
